The '''LE-5''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Orlean]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Orlean LE-5 was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[August 4]], [[2015]] as a mount exclusive to the Cartel Market.

*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
